terms.comment: Our description; no reference work has a word. Hāmātus is classically hooked (Ov.), and Cicero uses it of the hooked atoms that cling together, hāmātīs uncinātīsque corporibus (Ac. 2.121, in Lewis & Short). Shoes that fasten with it: calceī hāmātī.

phrases.english: Do up your velcro shoes yourself.

sources: Lewis & Short: taenia · Lewis & Short: hamatus
